result:
Build passes cleanly. Summary of what was implemented for SPEC §4 (Health / HealthKit):

- **`modules/expo-health/`** — new local Expo module (Swift, autolinked) wrapping `HKHealthStore` for the step-count type: `getAuthorizationStatus`, `requestAuthorization`, `logSteps(count)`, and `getLast7DaysSteps` (via `HKStatisticsCollectionQuery` with daily cumulative sums, all sources).
- **`app.json`** — added `NSHealthShareUsageDescription`/`NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription` and the HealthKit entitlement so prebuild generates correct native config.
- **`screens/HealthScreen.tsx`** — wired to the module: status line reflects write-authorization state, refreshes on focus, `Log 500 Steps` enabled only when granted, Last 7 Days list renders exactly 7 rows (`Fri Jul 25 — 1,000 steps`, today emphasized/suffixed), falls back to `Health access needed` when denied, and surfaces native errors in the status line.

`npx expo prebuild --platform ios && xcodebuild ... build` succeeds with no errors or warnings from the new code.
